headline: Renames a Beaverton, Michigan post office building after Colonel Alfred Asch.
what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 362 North Ross Street in Beaverton, Michigan, the "Colonel Alfred Asch Post Office." It is a naming measure only and does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 6, 2018, and the designation took effect on that date.
